name: memdb
description: A searchable memory database (SQLite full-text search) for Claude: search/add/get/index tools, a /memdb command, and your memory files indexed automatically

python.title: Python command
python.description: Python 3.8+ command used to run bin/memdb.py (default python3)

dbPath.title: Database path
dbPath.description: Where the database file lives. Empty = ~/.claude/memdb/memory.db (or $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/memdb/memory.db)

promptNote.title: Tell Claude about the tools
promptNote.description: Add a short note to the system prompt: search memdb before rereading long notes, store niche facts with memdb_add
